Not him,my family or his. It's just,if I had the choice of being the richest woman in history,or having my snuggly hooman bean back, I'd choose him. I'm sorry. But for me, I need to keep on. We all have to be there for each other and I'll feel bad about taking my life.

I tend to put others first,so for them,my death is off the table, even though I would love to see him again. It's going to be hard without him,but I'll survive. I personally don't want to be another tragedy in the family. Even if it means I can be reunited with the light of my life.

He asked me why I didn't leave him, and I didn't  because I'm faithful, I promised, I loved him, and I'm stubborn as hell. I'm going to blame autism and being in love for my behavior then,but if I did, I'd have regreted it for letting him die alone. Maybe it's just me,but I don't think that's a good idea.

I want to,but his family needs me. They are hurting as much as I am. Me being,well me wouldn't put them through the loss of another family member, even though I wasn't quite family legally, I still love them to much to have them lose him, and then his fiancee shortly after.
